stages.headline: Find GCD(27, 36).
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Divisors of 27: 1, 3, 9, 27. 2. 9 divides 36, 27 does not. 3. GCD 9.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. Divisors of 27: 1, 3, 9, 27. 2. 9 divides 36, 27 does not. 3. GCD 9.

stages.headline: Are 9 and 16 coprime?
stages.solutionSteps: 1-2. List divisors. 3. Only 1 in common: yes.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1-2. List divisors. 3. Only 1 in common: yes.

stages.headline: Rods of 48 cm and 60 cm are cut into equal pieces as long as possible. How long is one piece?
stages.headlineEnglish: Rods of 48 cm and 60 cm are cut into equal pieces as long as possible. How long is one piece?
stages.problemText: Rods of 48 cm and 60 cm are cut into equal pieces as long as possible. How long is one piece?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. It must divide 48 and 60. 2. GCD 12 cm.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. It must divide 48 and 60. 2. GCD 12 cm.
